intro.title: 1. Overview
intro.body: By using panelim.az, you agree to these terms. The platform provides software tools for customer messaging, inquiries, and booking management.

usage.title: 2. Acceptable Use
usage.body: Users agree not to use the service for unsolicited spam, illegal content, or unauthorized messaging. Compliance with Meta and third-party policies is required.

liability.title: 3. Limitation of Liability
liability.body: The service is provided as-is. panelim.az is not liable for third-party outages on messaging platforms such as WhatsApp, Instagram, or Telegram.

contact.title: 4. Contact & Support
contact.body: For questions regarding our terms, please reach out via our website Contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Safeguarding your customer and business data is our fundamental commitment.

collection.title: 1. Information We Collect
collection.body: We store only essential contact data such as customer names, phone numbers, message logs, and booking times required to deliver the service.

isolation.title: 2. Strict Tenant Data Separation
isolation.body: Each center's data lives in an isolated schema and database scope. One center can never access or view another center's records.

thirdParties.title: 3. No Third-Party Data Selling
thirdParties.body: We never sell, rent, or distribute your customer contact lists or business conversations to third parties.

contact.title: 4. Data Deletion Requests
contact.body: You may request full deletion of your center's data at any time by contacting our support team through our Contact form.
